description: This file defines the 'ColumnLeft' class within the OpenCart admin system. It generates the data for the left-hand navigation column in the admin interface, including menu items, extensions, fraud extensions, and statistics. The class's index method compiles and returns the HTML view for the sidebar.

classes.name: ColumnLeft
classes.description: Handles the generation of the administrator's left sidebar menu in the OpenCart backend, including standard menu items, dynamically loaded extensions, fraud extensions, and statistics summaries.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Compiles menu data, loads extensions and fraud modules, computes statistics, and renders the 'common/column_left' view for the admin sidebar.
